verses.text: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

segments.text: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

verses.text: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

segments.text: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

verses.text: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

segments.text: Iniquities prevail against me:
as for
our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

notes: 65.3 Iniquities: Heb. Words, or, Matters of iniquities

verses.text: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

segments.text: Blessed
is the man whom

unto thee, that
he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house,
even
of thy holy temple.

verses.text: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

segments.text: By
terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation;
who art
the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off
upon
the sea:

verses.text: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

segments.text: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains;
being
girded with power:

verses.text: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

segments.text: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

verses.text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

segments.text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.text: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

segments.text: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God,
which
is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

notes: 65.9 and…: or, after thou hadst made it to desire rain

verses.text: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

segments.text: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

notes: 65.10 settlest: or, causest rain to descend into

verses.text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

segments.text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

verses.text: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

segments.text: They drop
upon
the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

notes: 65.12 rejoice…: Heb. are girded with joy

verses.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

segments.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

headings.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm and Song of David.
